create_BoxSpace: create a BoxSpace with low and high bounds for continuous action spaces
sample_BoxSpace: sample a random element uniformly from a BoxSpace continuous space
get_low_high_bounds: get the lower and upper bound tensors of a BoxSpace instance
convert_gym_to_BoxSpace: convert a Gymnasium Box space to a BoxSpace using the from_gym static method
check_is_continuous: check if a BoxSpace is a continuous space using the is_continuous property
